app.name: Datacenter Builder Simulator
app.tagline: Build a data center. Rate it. Certify it.
landing.feature1.title: Lego-style builder
landing.feature1.body: Drag blocks into a 32×8×32 voxel grid. Real-world dimensions. Real-world power, cooling, and security trade-offs.
landing.feature2.title: Standards-cited scoring
landing.feature2.body: Your build is rated against Uptime Institute, TIA-942, EN 50600, ASHRAE, NFPA, ISO 27001, and the EU/SG/DE/CN energy codes.
landing.feature3.title: Verifiable certificate
landing.feature3.body: Download an SVG certificate with a QR code. Optionally push to Credly as a portable digital badge.

consent.title: We respect your privacy
consent.body: We do not use third-party analytics by default. If you opt in, we collect anonymous, aggregated usage data to improve the simulator. You can change this at any time in Settings.
